bootstrap_rule.const: authority.json configures root ceilings and Activation only. Root command proofs bind one command intent and may issue only the first authority.manage Grant. Every Grant proof binds claim_digest; later Grants cite an active authority.manage issuer Grant or team signatures verified by the exact signature adapter selected in technologies.json.

const.purpose: Activate one digest-bound repository configuration.
Issue or revoke runtime Grants within a configured root ceiling.
Create, split, order, or block Tasks.
Execute one Task inside its WorkCard and valid Lease.
Acquire, heartbeat, close, expire, or revoke Leases.
Publish candidate-bound evidence Artifacts.
Evaluate gates without promotion or release authority.
Record Findings.
Resolve one Finding only with evidence bound to that Finding's canonical digest.
Waive one Finding only through an expiring exception-policy Decision, Finding-bound evidence, and separation of duties.
Promote a validated Candidate.
Record an immutable historical release judgement bound to an exact acceptance-closure and provider-binding digest; current eligibility remains derived.
Create a sanitized external package.
Execute cutover, rollback, and deterministic recutover.
Rebuild or verify non-authoritative projections.

Read one bounded current projection or resume its continuation under the exact current Grant claim; it grants no mutation, validation, promotion, product acceptance, or standard distribution authority.

const.authorization_rule: Initial retrieval and every continuation resume require a current projection.read Grant whose subject, grant_id, claim_digest, capability, Activation, conjunctive requested scope, interval, and revocation state match the token claims exactly.
const.default_budget_source: selected Preset profile max_context_bytes, max_entities, max_relations, max_fanout_per_entity, and top_k
const.revocation_rule: Expired, revoked, substituted, stale, mismatched, or unresolved Grant claims reject before projection continuation.
const.secret_lifecycle: Generate one random 32-byte secret per Activation, store it only under .promin/state/secrets with restrictive permissions, never derive it from public package or control digests, never journal or export it, and rotate it with Activation.
const.selected_profile_digest_rule: sha256(canonical exact selected Preset profile object)
const.state_digest_rule: sha256(canonical full ContinuationTokenClaims); the compact token MAC binds token version, opaque state_id, state digest, Activation, subject, Grant claim, and expiry
const.token_envelope: promin-v2.<base64url opaque 128-bit state handle>.<lowercase state digest>.<base64url HMAC-SHA256>

event_batch_commitment_rule.authority_commitment: sha256(canonical object with exactly previous_authority_commitment, sequence, previous_batch_digest, event_count, event_semantic_digest, state_binding_update_count, state_binding_digest)
event_batch_commitment_rule.cumulative_event_count: previous cumulative_event_count plus current events length
event_batch_commitment_rule.cumulative_state_binding_update_count: previous cumulative state-binding update count plus current state_binding_delta length
event_batch_commitment_rule.event_semantic_digest: ordered append-only digest over every canonical Event
event_batch_commitment_rule.previous_authority_commitment: exact previous EventBatch authority_commitment; sequence one uses genesis_previous_authority_commitment
event_batch_commitment_rule.state_binding_delta: nonempty canonical ordered unique set/delete updates over changed typed authority leaves only
event_batch_commitment_rule.state_binding_digest: exact typed-sparse-merkle-v1 post-batch authority root using runtime domain separators for leaf and internal nodes; never a full serialized state hash

state_binding_algorithm_contract.delete_rule: delete maps the keyed leaf to empty_leaf
state_binding_algorithm_contract.leaf_key_rule: sha256(canonical bytes of exact object leaf_type and leaf_id)

const.state_binding_identity_rule: direct uses the exact id field; typed_digest_id uses prefix plus first 48 lowercase hex characters of sha256(canonical ordered id_fields array)

Activation.value_digest_rule: sha256(canonical installed Activation record); installed before sequence one and immutable for the journal

Grant.value_digest_rule: sha256(canonical exact GrantAuthorityState containing the current Grant and null or exact current GrantRevocation)

function.const: Own action capabilities, runtime Grant semantics, trust modes, configured signature-adapter verification, root ceilings, and separation-of-duty constraints.

const.claim_digest_rule: sha256(canonical Grant without claim_digest and trust_proofs)

model_tier_rule.const: Model strength changes decomposition, context, parallelism, and analysis depth; it never changes authority.

const.evidence_key_scope: Every evidence producer key is independently pinned to an exact subject, evidence role, platform, public key, validity interval, and revocation state.
const.separation_rule: For one candidate, an evidence-producing subject or key cannot hold standard.distribute, and a distribution decider subject or key cannot hold evidence.produce.

const.chain: exact candidate bytes -> StandardReleaseCandidateBinding -> seven unique stable-read authority-role records plus one non-authoritative exact eight-lane matrix and four CP314 supplemental records -> physically resolved StandardReleaseEvidenceManifest -> signed approve or reject StandardReleaseDecision -> independently pinned trust root -> derived distribution status
const.chronology: Every evidence invocation starts no later than it completes; its attestation time equals completion and stays within bounded verifier skew. Nested physical runs complete no later than their outer saturation audit, human review occurs inside its signed invocation, and max_evidence_completed_at is derived from all seven authority records, all nested physical records, and all four CP314 supplemental records. decided_at follows that maximum, is no more than 300 seconds beyond verifier time, and every producer/decision key is valid at its event time.
const.derived_truths: ExactPackageVerification is recomputed by the verifier and multi-platform implementation closure is derived only from fully authenticated Windows and Linux records; neither is an independently supplied required role or public command.
const.evidence_binding: Every authority, supplemental, matrix, and nested physical record binds exact path, SHA-256, and byte count and is read through a bounded handle-relative no-follow component walk. The manifest rejects symlink/junction/reparse/root substitution and NFC/casefold collisions, validates exact Draft 2020-12 schemas, verifies domain-separated producer attestations, binds producer/tool, role, platform, invocation, raw artifacts, and exact candidate, and runs role-specific semantic recomputation. The aggregate matrix remains non-authoritative with pass_credit=false and all acceptance/public flags false.
const.history_and_current_state: The signed StandardReleaseDecision and its digest remain immutable history. Current distribution eligibility is a derived view and becomes false when evidence, trust pin, candidate identity, chronology, key validity, or any required gate no longer validates.
const.independent_trust_binding: Manifest construction and closure verification require an independently operator-pinned SHA-256 for the exact trust configuration bytes. Exactly seven evidence roles have one distinct key, subject, and public key each; CP313 and CP314 observations for one role reuse only that role's configured producer. A mismatched, missing, duplicate, over-broad, or invalid scope cannot yield evidence credit or approval.
const.publication_rule: Only outcome approve signed by an active configured Ed25519 key with standard.distribute capability and verified against an independently pinned trust-root SHA-256 yields approved distribution status. Missing, rejected, stale, unsigned, mismatched, unpinned, fabricated, or unresolved records fail closed.
const.rule: StandardReleaseDecision is external to the canonical standard bytes, binds candidate and evidence manifest digests, includes explicit outcome and anti-replay nonce, proves decider authority through a configured trust root and signature provider, and cannot elevate a trust root delivered by the same untrusted source without an independent digest pin.

team-signed.provider_resolution: Resolve the exact technologies.json signature binding for init and every ActivationGuard, service, CLI, replay, and mutation path. A process-local injected adapter is explicitly non-reconstructable and valid only while bound to the same project, Activation, provider, and identity; cross-process CLI workflows require a reconstructable configured adapter.

const.name: no-false-success
const.statement: Gate pass credit is true exactly when normalized status is pass and every required gate passes.

const.name: activation-binding
const.statement: Every authoritative record binds the exact active Core, preset, init, and profile configuration.

const.name: grant-validity
const.statement: Subject, capability, conjunctive scope, interval, nonce, exact claim digest, proof chain, revocation state, and Activation all match.

const.name: lease-fence
const.statement: Every mutation uses the current active Lease generation and monotonic fencing token.

const.name: candidate-evidence-binding
const.statement: Every evidence Artifact requires an explicit diagnostic, gate, or product purpose and binds Activation, candidate, policy, provider/tool, and input digests inside the immutable event payload.

const.name: atomic-event-commit
const.statement: One command produces one immutable batch under lock, compare-head, sync, atomic replace, and recovery.

const.name: projection-is-derived
const.statement: Projection deletion and deterministic replay cannot change normative meaning.

const.name: minimal-graph
const.statement: Each verified raw file creates exactly one non-authoritative derived Artifact proxy. Raw inventory creates no Task, READS, or PRODUCES record; Tasks and typed relations require explicit semantic content.

const.name: bounded-workcard
const.statement: Every WorkCard stays within both Core hard ceilings and its selected profile byte, entity, relation, fanout, and top-k budgets; every truncation is explicit and losslessly resumable.

const.name: size-independent-init
const.statement: Initialization performs zero product-tree scans and creates exactly five init records.

const.name: explicit-external-bindings
const.statement: External standards and providers exist only in explicit digest-bound init records.

const.name: canonical-name-only
const.statement: The canonical identity is promin; aliases, redirects, and compatibility names are rejected.

const.name: safe-export
const.statement: Export is allowlisted, recursively bounded, symlink-safe, secret-aware, and path-sanitized.

const.name: closed-acknowledgement
const.statement: Only a valid CLOSED transition with explicit close acknowledgement releases a mutation slot.

const.name: fail-closed-critical-fields
const.statement: Missing, unknown, stale, downgraded, or unbound critical fields reject before mutation.

const.name: preset-capability-ceiling
const.statement: A preset may configure provider needs and budgets but cannot grant action authority.

const.name: single-scan-inventory
const.statement: One requested inventory performs at most one full product-tree pass; all projections derive from its stream.

const.name: idempotent-commands
const.statement: A duplicate idempotency key under the same activation and subject returns the original result or a conflict.

const.name: core-preset-separation
const.statement: Core bundle identity excludes replaceable presets; Activation binds the selected preset separately.

const.name: acyclic-bootstrap-authority
const.statement: Init config defines root ceilings, never pre-activation runtime Grants.

const.name: normalization-collision-rejection
const.statement: Duplicate JSON keys and path or ID collisions after NFC/casefold normalization are rejected.

const.name: provider-substitution-binding
const.statement: A provider identity or implementation-closure change invalidates the Activation and every dependent continuation, evidence Artifact, projection, replay result, and current release closure; it never silently changes authority.

const.name: exact-init-keyset
const.statement: Activation binds exactly project.json, standards.json, technologies.json, and authority.json.

const.name: stale-projection-rejection
const.statement: Status, next, and WorkCard generation reject a projection whose source head or activation differs.

const.name: one-command-one-batch
const.statement: Every committed batch binds exactly one subject, validated command digest, command intent digest, authorization digest, and idempotency key.

const.name: deterministic-retrieval
const.statement: Ranking ties are deterministic and acceptance-critical facts are added by typed closure, not fuzzy ranking.

const.name: strict-time-order
const.statement: Timestamps use canonical UTC seconds and issued, heartbeat, expiry, finish, and decision order is semantically checked.

const.name: exact-standard-files
const.statement: Core and selected preset inputs reject symlinks and unexpected shadow files.

const.name: root-authorization-is-bootstrap-only
const.statement: Root command authorization signs one command intent and may issue the first authority.manage Grant only; it cannot execute ordinary project commands.

const.name: configuration-exact-idempotency
const.statement: Repeated initialization succeeds only when the requested canonical configuration digest exactly equals the existing Activation; otherwise it reports conflict.

const.name: truthful-observability
const.statement: A command may report a scan, healthcheck, validation, or durability action only when that action was actually executed and evidence-bound.

const.name: depth-aware-retrieval-budget
const.statement: Effective retrieval seed count reserves entity and relation capacity for typed closure at the requested dependency depth; top_k is a ceiling, byte/entity/relation/fanout budgets all remain effective, and no removed or unknown budget field may bypass a ceiling.

const.name: lease-only-for-mutation
const.statement: Mutation WorkCards require the current Lease; read-only WorkCards must not acquire or carry a mutation Lease.

const.name: command-capability-scope
const.statement: Every command resolves to exactly one Core-owned capability; requested scope retains every authorization constraint and explicitly contains every command effect target.

const.name: grant-issuance-chain
const.statement: Every Grant proof binds claim_digest and is either the one bootstrap root issuance, a verified team threshold, or an active authority.manage issuer Grant.

const.name: verified-team-signatures
const.statement: Team-signature fields are never valid without threshold evaluation by the signature adapter resolved from the exact technologies binding; process-local injected adapters are explicitly non-reconstructable and cannot prove a cross-process CLI workflow.

const.name: provider-preflight-before-activation
const.statement: Every required provider identity and healthcheck succeeds before initialization is committed; a declared provider is not evidence of availability.

const.name: canonical-state-machines
const.statement: Task and Lease transitions are accepted only by the policy-owned state machines; generated lifecycle views cannot invent transitions.

const.name: decision-target-binding
const.statement: Every Decision names one typed target and the decision kind, requested scope, candidate, and authority are consistent with that target.

const.name: credit-requires-evidence
const.statement: Pass, fail, and blocked gate results cite at least one exact immutable Artifact record reference; skipped results never receive pass credit.

const.name: command-event-correspondence
const.statement: One command batch binds the exact authorization claim and contains exactly one primary event equal to the validated command payload; auxiliary events are typed relations only and event IDs are unique.

const.name: continuation-authorization-and-completeness
const.statement: A continuation is authenticated by a random per-Activation secret and binds the exact subject, projection.read Grant claim, capability, requested scope, revocation state, normalized query, deterministic cursor, Activation, HEAD, projection, ranking, complete budgets, depth, implementation closure, issue time, and expiry; its complete page union emits every reachable entity and relation exactly once without loss.

const.name: candidate-snapshot-consistency
const.statement: The candidate recipe is applied in the single inventory pass; promin v1 permits only provider-proven immutable VCS trees for credit, while best-effort observations are explicit and receive no pass credit.

const.name: provider-adapter-dispatch
const.statement: Every technologies.json binding resolves to the adapter actually invoked and carries a recomputed capability-specific implementation closure for the promin runtime, Python interpreter, jsonschema or SQLite component where used, and adapter. Unsupported or drifted tuples reject, and dependent evidence binds the exact implementation_closure_digest.

const.name: current-release-closure
const.statement: A project-operational release Decision is immutable history; current product release eligibility is derived and becomes false after a blocker, failed gate, stale or missing evidence, implementation drift, or Activation drift. It is separate from the external StandardReleaseDecision for promin distribution.

const.name: finding-disposition-evidence
const.statement: Every Finding cites exact immutable Artifact record references. Every resolve or waive Decision cites evidence bound to the exact canonical Finding digest; waiver also requires an exception-policy digest, future expiry, and separation of duties.

const.name: candidate-delta-scope
const.statement: A diff Artifact binds base and new Candidate digests, the exact WorkCard digest, and the complete changed-path set; every changed path is contained by both Task allowed_paths and the authorizing Grant effect scope.

const.name: verified-state-checkpoint
const.statement: Events remain the sole authority. A normal command appends O(batch), incrementally updates changed projection rows/shards, and advances a verified bounded replay tail. Full derived-state compaction occurs only after declared batch/byte thresholds or explicit recovery, publishes crash-safely against exact HEAD, and missing, stale, or corrupt checkpoints require full verified fallback with equal semantic digest.

const.name: profile-default-depth
const.statement: A profile default_dependency_depth applies only when depth is omitted; explicit depth is accepted through the single Core dependency_depth_hard_max of 12 and remains subject to all retrieval budgets.

const.name: canonical-distribution-archive
const.statement: The sole package builder emits immutable candidate bytes and an external StandardReleaseCandidateBinding. VERSION.json describes SemVer and package identity only; approval is derived later and never changes the candidate ZIP.

const.name: verified-inventory-provenance
const.statement: Public rebuild accepts only a verified InventoryResult or its persisted manifest; caller provenance fields are reserved, data_class is forced to untrusted-source, and runtime injects the exact path and digest.

const.name: supported-command-surface
const.statement: The v1 preset advertises exactly init, doctor, status, next, validate, and continue; no optional or administrative command catalogue may claim an absent executable path.

const.name: profile-bound-scale
const.statement: Physical 100k evidence binds content-addressed raw inventory, query, continuation, process-sample, phase-log, and operation-metric artifacts for at least 198999 explicitly recorded Core-valid typed Relations and a representative mixed workload. The verifier recomputes every summary and fails closed on truthful process/invocation status, commit p95/p99, bytes per changed record, checkpoint count, semantic-ingestion time, search latency, incremental inventory memory amplification, absolute peak RSS, database bytes, projection amplification, semantic inflation, continuation completeness, or traversal-pass ceiling.

const.name: cross-platform-release-evidence
const.statement: The exact candidate ZIP must pass authenticated Windows and Linux platform observations, clean-install, package, handle-relative path/race, locking, crash, replay, physical scale, offline installed no-degradation, online compatibility, dependency/SBOM/RECORD/license closure, and typed PDF gates. One StandardReleaseEvidenceManifest physically resolves exactly seven unique authority roles, the exact non-authoritative eight-lane CPython 3.13/3.14 online/offline matrix, all four CPython 3.14 supplemental records, and every nested physical record by path, SHA-256, and byte count. All producer attestations bind the same candidate and participate in one replay/SOD/chronology graph; matrix_authoritative, pass_credit, acceptance_pass, product_acceptance_pass, and public approval remain false.

const.name: standard-release-separation
const.statement: An external StandardReleaseDecision has explicit approve or reject outcome, binds candidate and evidence manifest digests, follows the manifest-derived maximum evidence completion time, stays within 300 seconds of verifier clock skew, and verifies decider, standard.distribute capability, independently pinned trust root, Ed25519 provider, event-time key validity, nonce, signed claim digest, and signature. The signed decision remains immutable history; current eligibility is derived; product_acceptance_pass is false and product_public_approval is not_approved.

const.name: required-gates-fail-closed
const.statement: No-degradation runs the complete required suite only through the clean installed interpreter outside the install source, with isolated mode, cleared PYTHONPATH, import-origin assertion, zero skipped tests, and full hash-bound JUnit/stdout/stderr bytes. Distribution acceptance executes every required positive, mutation, concurrency, crash, replay, path, package, platform, Python-minor, offline/online, scale, search, PDF, evidence-resolution, chronology, and signature gate; a skipped, missing, stale, blocked, failed, unsigned, unresolved, source-shadowed, or unpinned gate receives no pass credit.

const.name: research-draft-sanitation
const.statement: Research crosses into normative owners only through the non-persistent MIGRATE_FACTS_NOT_FILES intake: every cited source is digest- and license-plan-bound, citation-required claims cite allowed sources or remain blocked with a reason, and marketing, proof, distribution, acceptance, or public-approval claims cannot become normative text.

const.name: doctor-result-is-live-non-authority
const.statement: DoctorResult is an exact live-only derived health report with report_authoritative=false, pass_credit=false, product_acceptance_pass=false, product_public_approval=not_approved, zero product scans, and only its Core-owned operational metrics; token, cost, usage, and goal/session/batch/workspace/per-run allocation are forbidden.

const.name: semantic-inheritance-is-structural
const.statement: The compiled projection preserves the complete SemanticModel owner: admission, five independent granularities, promotion rules, exact entity purposes and admission rules, exact relation domain/range/rules, and structured provider forbidden boundaries.

const.name: authority-owner-is-structural
const.statement: AuthorityModel is the single owner of the capability catalogue, delegation depth, and exact separation-of-duty pairs; runtime policy may derive from that Activation-bound owner but may not substitute hardcoded authority facts.

const.name: gate-run-definition-is-independent
const.statement: An immutable GateRunDefinition independently owns the expected evidence class, product-credit requirement, exact target scope, and candidate, policy, tool, provider, and input digests. A run or gate command binds its exact definition digest before submitted Artifacts are evaluated.

const.name: authority-runtime-policy-is-derived-live-only
const.statement: AuthorityRuntimePolicy is rebuilt from the installed AuthorityModel for every mutation and replay, binds the exact owner digest, ordered capability IDs, structured separation-of-duty rules and delegation ceiling, and is never persisted or imported as authority.

const.name: semantic-export-is-export-only
const.statement: SemanticExport is a strict bounded export-only semantic-state record binding the exact Candidate, Activation, HEAD, Core, preset, implementation closure, providers, inputs, and output. It is neither a package nor archive and cannot carry product acceptance, pass credit, public approval, or release approval.

const.name: operation-metrics-are-live-observations
const.statement: OperationMetrics is a strict live-only non-authoritative observation for one command. It permits only Core-owned duration, changed-record, write, projection, checkpoint, and physical-byte fields and forbids token, cost, usage, and goal/session/batch/workspace/per-run allocation.

const.name: workcard-projection-is-v2-live-only
const.statement: RetrievalPage is the strict bounded live-only v2 retrieval result and exclusively owns stream_cursor, next_stream_cursor, and retrieval continuation. WorkCardProjection is internal selected-Task materialization and exposes no continuation or cursor fields.

const.name: event-store-policy-is-derived-live-only
const.statement: EventStorePolicy is rebuilt from the installed AuthorityModel before normalization, mutation, and replay. It binds exact command and batch bounds, envelope and commitment fields, lease-bound commands and states, primary-event mapping, and UTC-second timestamps, with no defaults or nullable critical fields.

const.name: depends-on-graph-is-acyclic
const.statement: Every command, import, replay, and rebuild rejects a DEPENDS_ON cycle. Relation domain and range validity alone cannot admit a cyclic dependency graph.

const.name: ready-frontier-is-current-derived-state
const.statement: ReadyFrontier is derived live-only from the current acyclic DEPENDS_ON graph. A READY Task is returned only after every dependency is currently COMPLETED, every required GateResult is current passing credit, and no current OPEN Finding blocks it; ordering and continuation are deterministic and truncation is explicit.

const.claim_digest_rule: sha256(canonical complete claim excluding claim_digest and derived normative_use_allowed)
const.evidence_reference_rule: citation_refs identify research sources; evidence_refs identify independently resolved Artifact records; the sets are semantically distinct
const.metadata_only_rule: missing payload receipt is representable only by source_mode metadata-only and every referencing claim remains blocked, non-authoritative, and normative_use_allowed=false
const.normative_candidate_rule: only a source-bound or verified evidence_claim classified fact with eligible citations and resolved evidence_refs may become a sanitized normative candidate
const.source_license_rule: allowed only when the active LicensesPlan binding review_state is reviewed or source-verified

const.input_digests_rule: sorted unique sha256(canonical exported record) values for the exact replay-derived record set
const.output_artifact_record_digest_rule: sha256(canonical finalized record with exact artifact and authoritative commit_binding)
const.output_bytes_rule: exact canonical SemanticStatePayload bytes stored in content-addressed storage

const.derived_by_default: Each raw inventory file yields exactly one derived Artifact proxy. Raw-file proxies never create a persistent Task or relation; persistence still requires an independent invariant.

artifact_subtypes.candidate-delta: An Artifact with kind diff binds one base Candidate, one new Candidate, one WorkCard, and the complete normalized changed-path set.
artifact_subtypes.evidence: An evidence Artifact binds exact Candidate, policy, tool, inputs, and every invoked provider adapter; Finding disposition evidence additionally binds the canonical Finding digest.

candidate_consistency.creditable: Only an immutable-vcs-tree provider may produce a creditable Candidate in promin v1.
candidate_consistency.observational: A best-effort filesystem observation is explicit, non-creditable, and cannot receive product or release pass credit.
candidate_consistency.recipe_binding: Candidate identity binds the exact candidate_recipe digest, including include, exclude, path identity, collision, and symlink rules.

implementation_closure.activation_binding: Activation binds the aggregate digest of every capability-specific implementation closure.
implementation_closure.binding_shape: Each TechnologiesInit binding carries runtime, interpreter, zero or more capability components, exactly one matching adapter, and a recomputed closure_digest.
implementation_closure.stale_rule: A runtime, interpreter, component, adapter, or closure digest change invalidates the Activation and every dependent evidence Artifact, projection, continuation, and current release closure.

inventory_projection.input: Only a verified InventoryResult or its persisted manifest may enter the public rebuild path.
inventory_projection.one_file_rule: Each verified raw file produces exactly one InventoryProjectionRow and one deterministic derived Artifact proxy.
inventory_projection.search_text_rule: exact NFC-normalized canonical path, UTF-8 bounded by Conformance scale_contracts.inventory.search_text_bytes_max
inventory_projection.stream_artifact_record_digest_rule: sha256(canonical finalized record with exact artifact and authoritative commit_binding)

provider_invocation_evidence.full_output_rule: output_digest and output_size_bytes cover the complete provider operation output stream; they are never derived from the bounded diagnostic captures
provider_invocation_evidence.immutable_tree_stream_rule: filesystem-inventory immutable-tree-stream digests and counts the complete raw archive stream while stdout/stderr captures remain bounded diagnostics
provider_invocation_evidence.invocation_request_digest_rule: sha256(canonical pre-invocation request receipt binding exact argv or module call, configured cwd, stdin digest, selected output ceiling, environment allowlist, provider identity, dependency receipt, and implementation closure)
provider_invocation_evidence.selected_ceiling_rule: output_size_ceiling_bytes is the exact operation or configured-workspace ceiling selected before invocation, does not exceed full_output_bytes_hard_max, and rejects output_size_bytes above it

function.const: Own the minimal persistent vocabulary, relation grammar, derived-projection boundary, and provider capability contracts.

const.purpose: Represent one schedulable unit with one acceptance predicate and bounded mutation scope.
Identify either one provider-proven immutable product snapshot or one explicitly non-creditable observation, independently from control state and bound to the exact candidate recipe.

Identify immutable product, evidence, log, report, or diff bytes with provenance and retention metadata; raw-file inventory produces only derived Artifact proxies, while a diff may carry the canonical Candidate-delta change manifest without creating another persistent entity.
Record one execution or validation attempt against exact candidate, policy, tool, and input digests.
Record an observed defect or policy violation with explicit effective-blocking semantics.
Record a project-operational acceptance, rejection, resolution, waiver, promotion, or release judgement. It is distinct from the external StandardReleaseDecision for the standard distribution.

Record one gate outcome against the exact immutable Task-owned GateRunDefinition, current Run, and finalized evidence Artifact records; skipped, blocked, failed, stale, or unresolved evidence never receives pass credit.
Prove one subject capability within one activation, time interval, nonce, and scope.
Coordinate temporary mutation ownership through generation, fencing, expiry, heartbeat, and close acknowledgement.

const.task: Parse explicit configuration, canonicalize JSON, and run local CLI orchestration.
Validate the single Draft 2020-12 contract bundle with enforced formats and local references.
Compute content digests and content-addressed object identities.
Provide one local-writer lock, atomic replace, file sync, directory sync, and recovery primitives.

Build disposable status and bounded typed-retrieval projections; derive ReadyFrontier, materialize one exact WorkCardProjection, and return Core-owned NextResult or ContinueResult envelopes for the six supported CLI commands.
Apply the exact candidate recipe in one product pass, use no-follow reads, and publish either a provider-proven immutable VCS tree stream or an explicit non-creditable observation.
Perform bounded recursive export inspection, allowlisting, secret classification, and symlink rejection.
Dispatch the exact configured signature adapter to sign or verify activation, Grant, and Decision digests for team trust mode, and evidence the invoked adapter identity.
Import project-specific build and dependency facts as derived projections.

const.CandidateDelta: A diff Artifact payload binding base and new Candidate digests, WorkCard digest, and the complete normalized changed-path set.
const.Command: A state-changing request validated before commit.
const.Comparator: A pure ordering or equality rule.
const.ContinuationToken: An authenticated bounded runtime value signed with the random per-Activation secret. It binds subject, exact projection.read Grant claim, requested scope, revocation state, normalized query, cursor, Activation, HEAD, projection, ranking, complete budgets, depth, implementation closure, issue time, and expiry; it never grants authority by itself.
const.CurrentReleaseStatus: A derived evaluation of an immutable historical release Decision against the current closure, blockers, evidence, providers, and Activation.
const.ImplementationClosure: A canonical capability-specific binding of the promin runtime, Python interpreter, jsonschema or SQLite component where used, exactly one adapter, and the recomputed aggregate closure digest.
const.Operation: One completed semantic step with explicit input, output, failure, and evidence semantics.
const.PlanProposal: A non-authoritative bounded proposal that derives candidate Tasks and relations from project intent, repository facts, backlog, and references; it cannot mutate operational state or grant authority.
const.Policy: A machine-addressable invariant owned by policy-set.json.
const.ProviderInvocationEvidence: The exact capability, provider, invocation kind, identity kind and digest, and adapter ID actually used by one operation.
const.Query: A read-only request that cannot mutate authoritative state.
const.StandardReleaseDecision: An external human-reviewable distribution record bound to the exact promin ZIP, Core, preset, tools, implementation closure, tests, platform results, saturation, PDFs, and evidence manifest. It never grants product acceptance.
const.StateCheckpoint: A disposable self-digested state or journal index bound to an exact authoritative HEAD; it cannot grant authority or acceptance.
const.WorkCard: A bounded generated context package for one Task that separately binds the projection.read query Grant claim and the task.execute holder Grant; neither binding implies acceptance.
